company.description: Rimba is an AI-powered platform that automates compliance and audit processes for industrial operations. The company focuses on manufacturing, oil and gas, and chemical companies. Its solutions streamline EPA compliance, carbon reporting, and tax credit documentation by transforming operational data into accurate compliance reports, thereby reducing manual work and errors.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven platform that automates data ingestion, monitoring, and reporting to manage compliance and audit processes for energy and industrial operations.

productsAndServices.description: A specialized module within Rimba for RNG producers that automates data reconciliation, carbon intensity tracking, and regulatory reporting to support credit monetization and audit readiness.
